name: reduce-context-tokens
description: Inventory host-tree context-token waste, ask consent, then draft an ordered reduction plan. Planning only; does not implement.

inputs.name: planning-consent
inputs.description: Optional prior consent to run reduction planning.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers accumulated across clarification loops.

outputs.name: reduction-plan
outputs.description: Markdown plan; empty if the user declined planning.

outputs.name: open-questions
outputs.description: Remaining blockers or follow-ups at handoff; copy from advisor blocking-questions when present.
